faq: What does an AI agent for a maid agency actually do on WhatsApp?

It answers the family's first messages on your own WhatsApp number at any hour. It quotes the levy, salary range and agency fee from your fee sheet, asks one qualifying question, sends the biodata your matching team approved, and books the interview with a relationship manager. When the case needs a person, it takes the family's details and hands over. 41 Labs builds it and runs it for you.
Can it quote the levy, salary and agency fee correctly?

It quotes whatever is on the sheet you give us and labels it as a guide. For example, it can tell a family that the concessionary levy is S$60 a month instead of S$300 when a parent lives with them. The exact figure for that family is always confirmed by your relationship manager. If your fees change, you send us the new sheet and the agent changes with it.
Will it promise MOM approval dates or say a helper is good with babies?

No. It answers fees and process only, and it never gives an approval date. On helpers it shows the biodata your team approved and the recorded video interview, and it says nothing about a helper that is not on that biodata. A question it cannot answer from your material goes to a relationship manager with the family's name and number.
Can it show helper biodata and video interviews?

Yes. On Starter you send us the profiles you want it to offer, with the video interview links, and it sends the right ones for the family's need. On Pro it reads your live catalogue, so a helper who was placed yesterday is not offered today. A profile can be put on hold for the relationship manager to follow up.
What happens when a family messages on a Saturday night?

It answers within the minute, works out a guide cost, sends two approved profiles and offers the next interview slot in your calendar, which may be Monday. The family has a figure and an interview time instead of a silent chat. In our study of 25 Singapore businesses, one replied within five minutes and the median wait for a human reply was 13.3 hours.
How much does it cost and is there a contract?

Starter is S$690 a month and Pro is S$1,490 a month. The build is included, and the only one-time cost is S$2,400 to connect a system of your own that we have connected before. You start with one month, charged from go-live, then month to month with 30 days notice and no contract. No GST is charged. Eligible Singapore SMEs can apply the EDGE grant, which replaced the EDG on 30 September 2026, to part of the cost, up to 70% of qualifying costs.
We are a small agency with a few enquiries a day. Is it worth it?

If your team already answers every message within the hour, weekends included, do not buy this. A website with a WhatsApp button will serve you better for now. It pays when enquiries wait overnight or a relationship manager spends her day on the same cost question. Count last month's unanswered weekend messages and decide from that.

Live in 48 hours from your material. Send us your fee sheet, the nationalities you place, your replacement terms, the biodata you want offered and your interview calendar.
